verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog documents private sub-teams for sensitive work, including a mode where the sub-team is hidden from everyone except directly invited members. Private teams also keep the initiatives they lead visible only to team members. Missing for 10: details on who can create sub-teams and the creation workflow (role or plan requirements), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create private sub-teams restricted to specific members

citations.quote: Private sub-teams organize groups that work together under one umbrella, like independent business units, skunkworks efforts, or teams handling sensitive data
Private to team members — the team is hidden, except to members directly invited to that sub-team
For work that requires tighter access, initiatives led by private teams are only visible to team members.
